lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh Oh, oh, oh, oh
Voices rise in the halls of men
Preaching rules built by the hands
Words of truth turned inside out
Lost in pride and holy sounds
They speak of light but dim the flame
Traditions all still bear the name
But wisdom cries from heaven's door Seek the truth and nothing more
Beware of the doctrines of men Don't stumble on the letter
Let the spirit guide you through Rightly divide the word of truth
The parchments twist beneath the pen Translations bent by heart cement
But grace remains, it calls your name Through every shadow, every chain
Lift your eyes and look above Study deep in His perfect love
A workman stands unashamed and new
Walking strong in the light of truth
Beware of the doctrines of men
Don't stumble on the ladder
Let the spirit guide you through
Rightly divide the world of truth
Not by power, not by might
But by the Spirit's holy light
Break the chains of worldly view
The living world will see you through
Beware of the doctrines of men
Hold fast to the truth within
Stand firm, your heart made new
Rightly divide the word of truth
